name: G&C Mutual Bank
legalName: Merged into Unity Bank Limited (ABN 72 087 650 637, AFSL/ACL 238311) on 7 March 2025; the G&C Mutual Bank brand has been retired

notes.value: G&C Mutual Bank no longer exists as a separate lender. Unity Bank states: "We are pleased to confirm that the official merger with G&C Mutual Bank took place on the 7th of March. This was the date that we became a combined legal entity, and the date that our banking systems integration took place" and "the Unity Bank Limited name will be retained". The domain gcmutual.bank now 301-redirects to unity.bank. Any new lending should be assessed against the 'unity-bank' record, which itself appears not to have a mortgage broker channel.
notes.sourceTitle: Unity Bank — Merger of Unity Bank and G&C Mutual Bank
notes.note: The Unity Bank page gives the merger day as "the 7th of March" without naming the year on-page. The year 2025 is taken from contemporaneous trade press (Mortgage Professional Australia, 'G&C Mutual and Unity Bank complete merger') and is consistent with Unity Bank's post-merger Target Market Determinations, which are effective 1 July 2025.

gaps: This lender no longer exists — status is 'withdrawn' because the entity merged into Unity Bank Limited on 7 March 2025 and the brand has been retired. The record is kept only so the id resolves and nothing is matched to it.
No G&C Mutual Bank credit policy, LVR caps, loan limits or broker material remain accessible: gcmutual.bank redirects to unity.bank and the historical pages are gone.
No evidence was found that G&C Mutual Bank ever operated a public broker channel; trade coverage of the merger stated that neither Unity nor G&C sourced new business through mortgage brokers.
All policy fields are deliberately empty. Do not populate this record — populate 'unity-bank' instead.
